Dumidistansya ng ilang dipa kapag kumakaldag
Pinapaos, pero kahit kailan di kinakapos
Sa kahit na ano pa mang era ay laging tumatagos

Humabol sa mga bago sa tunog ng kanilang meta

Ang tunay na pagkatao ko’y tumatak na sa mga tenga
Pag Roberto ang umareglo, ang mensahe ay direkta

Pakiramdam ko’y nagsisimula pa lang lahat

Di tumatanda, parang bokalista ng Chicosci
Istilo ay naka-upgrade, updated bawat kilobyte

Triple OG classic, parang AF1 na triple white
Lalabas kami sa feed mo kahit na hindi mo type

Kahit saan ako ay may fan na parang Jisulife
Hindi umeedad, Peter Pan and the Lost Boys
Mas matagal, mas mataas ang halaga, na parang Rolls-Royce

Bogznoit na naman kasi sinolo yung crossjoint
Lalong tumatagal, mas lalong tumatalim

Mas tumataas ang antas ng kaya pang gawin
Sapagkat kalabaw lang ang tumatanda, ’di ang mga kambing

snippet.description:

Lyrics:

Lay down with me
By the fire while we’re underneath
This canopy of galaxies
Can we stay together?  

I believe
If the universe will let us be
And we’re each other’s destiny
We should stay together 

I want to lay down by the fire with you
Where souls are glowing ever warmer too
Your love surrounds me like a lullaby
Singing softly you are mine oh mine

Moon has never glowed this color
Hearts have never been this close
I have never been more certain
I will love you 'til we're old

Maybe the night holds a little hope for us dear
Maybe we might want to settle down just be near
Stay together here

We follow the pull of fate into this moment
We follow the pull of fate into this moment

Moon has never glowed this color
Hearts have never been this close
I have never been more certain
I will love you 'til we're old

Maybe the night holds a little hope for us dear
Maybe we might want to settle down just be near
Stay together

In case there was doubt in your mind 
There’s no mountain that I won’t climb
There’s nothing in this earth that you won’t give
when it’s for the love of your life 

If it’s not you then
I don’t want anybody else
I will love you til we’re old

Maybe the night holds a little hope for us dear
Maybe we might want to settle down just be near
Maybe the night holds a little hope for us dear
Maybe we might want to settle down just be near

Stay together
Stay together
Here
